context: local gate dry-run without the soak result (2026-10-02 19:35 UTC); not a release record
criterion: p3_regression (P3 S0 matrix rerun by the P5 gate)
problems: harness_error:ScenarioTimeout: timed out waiting for queued on uav_a

timeline.scheduler: uav_a blocked (energy.cooling, from the last dock report); uav_b eligible and assigned

cause: Harness precondition race: part (ii) of F09 waits for the dock simulator's own energy state to read ready, not for the service to have received that report. When the task is created inside one report period, the scheduler correctly sees cooling and assigns uav_b, so the withdrawal the case expects never starts. The service behaved as designed.
history: P3 gate (73fcf23) and P4 gate (8f41112) ran this matrix 45/45
decision: No candidate change for a test-harness timing race; the release gate reruns the matrix on the spot after the soak, on an otherwise idle machine. Follow-up after P5: make F09 wait for the service-side dock energy (resources.list) before creating the second task.
